title: Cycle double cover conjecture
exact_target: Can every bridgeless graph be covered exactly twice by cycles, with repetitions allowed? The same source asks for oriented double and fourfold covers with equal forward and backward counts.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3161 (OPG-137). CC BY 4.0.
